citation: Manohar et al., Data-Driven Sparse Sensor Placement for Reconstruction: An Approach to Reduce Dimensionality, IEEE Control Systems Magazine, 38(3):63-86, 2018
task: Linear reconstruction of full state fields from sparse point measurements
objective: QR factorization with column pivoting (DEIM/Q-DEIM) on truncated spatial POD/PCA basis modes to maximize determinant / condition number
supervision: Unsupervised on state coordinates (reconstructs full field from sensors)
validation_design: Temporal sequences across geophysical (SST) and fluid dynamic regimes
closest_overlap: Sparse point sensor placement from PCA basis modes coupled with least-squares pseudo-inverse reconstruction
exact_potential_distinction: Pivots purely on static spatial variance modes from a single pooled dataset; lacks multi-environment cross-run transfer objectives or worst-case simulation trajectory minimax criteria.

citation: Glielmo et al., Ranking the information content of distance measures, PNAS, 118(47):e2107970118, 2021
task: Quantifying directional information flow and predictability between distance metrics in molecular configurations
objective: Information Imbalance Delta(A -> B) = 2/N sum(r_i^B | r_i^A = 1) - 1/N, evaluating nearest-neighbor rank preservation between metrics
supervision: Self-supervised metric comparison without regression target task
validation_design: Evaluated on synthetic manifolds, alanine dipeptide, and Trp-cage conformers
closest_overlap: Assessing subsets of pairwise molecular distances for structural information preservation
exact_potential_distinction: Non-differentiable rank metric for manifold distance comparison; does not optimize linear reconstruction SSE or minimize worst-case transfer error across independent simulation runs.

citation: Wild et al., Automatic feature selection and weighting in molecular systems using Differentiable Information Imbalance, Nature Communications, 15:10228, 2024
task: Continuous feature weighting and selection in molecular dynamics for reaction coordinates and collective variables
objective: Differentiable Information Imbalance (DII): continuous softmax kernel relaxing rank imbalance, optimized via gradient descent with sparsity penalty
supervision: Target-guided / semi-supervised (predicts full distance matrix or kinetic target)
validation_design: Peptide isomerization trajectories (alanine dipeptide, chignolin, polyproline)
closest_overlap: Automated selection and weighting of molecular distance features to preserve structural and dynamic information
exact_potential_distinction: Optimizes continuous weights via gradient descent on soft rank kernel within a single trajectory; does not solve the combinatorial sparse k-sensor selection problem under multi-run worst-case transfer shift.

citation: Wu and Noe, Variational approach for learning Markov processes from time series data, Journal of Nonlinear Science, 30:23-66, 2020
task: Learning dynamical coordinates and kinetic transition models (VAMP / VAMPnets) from molecular simulations
objective: Maximizing Rayleigh quotient / VAMP score across time-lagged covariance matrices
validation_design: Cross-validation across trajectory chunks for kinetic operator recovery
closest_overlap: Feature selection and coordinate projection for molecular simulation trajectories
exact_potential_distinction: Optimizes propagation of Markovian transition operators (kinetics), not static same-time geometric distance reconstruction under run-to-run initialization shift.

citation: Clark et al., Sensor Selection for Reconstructing High-Dimensional Complex Systems with Low-Rank Dynamics, IEEE Access, 7:92404-92418, 2019
task: Sparse sensor placement for reconstructing fluid and geophysical fields using custom basis representations
objective: Convex relaxation of optimal experiment design (D-optimal and A-optimal) combined with greedy QR pivoting
validation_design: Fluid flow simulations with varying Reynolds numbers and boundary conditions
closest_overlap: Greedy and convex sparse sensor subset selection for field reconstruction
exact_potential_distinction: Operates on stationary low-rank modes; lacks cross-run transfer objectives or worst-case minimax risk criteria.

citation: Sagawa et al., Distributionally Robust Neural Networks for Group Shifts: On the Importance of Regularization for Worst-Case Generalization, ICLR, 2020
task: Robust learning under spurious correlations and subgroup distribution shifts
objective: Group Distributionally Robust Optimization (Group DRO): min_theta max_{g in G} E_{(x,y)~P_g}[loss(f_theta(x), y)]
supervision: Supervised classification with known environment/group labels
validation_design: Waterbirds, CelebA, and MultiNLI under worst-group accuracy evaluation
closest_overlap: Minimax optimization over discrete predefined training environments/groups to guarantee worst-group performance
exact_potential_distinction: Optimizes neural network parameters via stochastic gradient descent across group losses; M8 applies the minimax criterion to combinatorial greedy feature/sensor selection for sparse physical distances in molecular simulations.

citation: Arjovsky et al., Invariant Risk Minimization, arXiv:1907.02894, 2019
objective: Minimizing empirical risk subject to an invariance constraint on the linear classifier across environments
validation_design: Synthetic distributionally shifted environments (colored MNIST) and causal graphs
closest_overlap: Formulation of multi-environment training to achieve robustness against non-stationary distribution shifts
exact_potential_distinction: IRM seeks an invariant representation via gradient penalties on linear decoders; M8 directly employs a discrete minimax transfer objective (min_S max_{e1 != e2} Err(e1 -> e2)) for greedy subset selection of physical sensors.

citation: Saito et al., Data-driven surface reconstruction using sparse sensor placement, Physics of Fluids, 33(5):057102, 2021
task: Reconstructing pressure and velocity fields from sparse surface measurements on aerodynamic bodies
objective: Greedy sensor placement maximizing determinant of measurement matrix coupled with ridge regression decoder
supervision: Supervised mapping from surface sensors to full flow fields
validation_design: Flow over circular cylinder and airfoils with test flow speed variations
closest_overlap: Greedy sparse sensor selection coupled to linear/ridge decoders for full field reconstruction
exact_potential_distinction: Evaluates sensors within steady or quasi-steady fluid regimes; does not evaluate cross-trajectory transfer or minimax cross-run error.

citation: Joshi and Boyd, Sensor Selection via Convex Optimization, IEEE Transactions on Signal Processing, 57(2):451-462, 2009
task: Selecting k out of m linear sensors to estimate an unknown parameter vector
objective: Minimizing error covariance volume/trace (log det(sum z_i a_i a_i^T)^-1) via semidefinite and convex relaxation
supervision: Linear measurement model with Gaussian observation noise
validation_design: Synthetic sensor networks and estimation benchmarks
closest_overlap: Formal convex mathematical formulation of sparse sensor subset selection
exact_potential_distinction: Assumes a known stationary linear forward measurement matrix A; does not address empirical data-driven reconstruction across independently drifting molecular dynamics trajectories.

citation: Ben-Tal, El Ghaoui, and Nemirovski, Robust Optimization, Princeton Series in Applied Mathematics, Princeton University Press, 2009
task: Mathematical optimization under uncertain parameters belonging to an uncertainty set
objective: Minimax robust counterpart formulation: min_x max_{u in U} f(x, u)
validation_design: Theoretical and algorithmic convex optimization proofs
closest_overlap: Foundational mathematical formulation of worst-case minimax risk
exact_potential_distinction: Foundational mathematical theory rather than an empirical sensor selection algorithm for molecular simulation trajectories.
